title: Oscar and the Cipher
author: Gideon Oyelaran
blurb: Silas Marchetti, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
